title: Agnihotra Havan & Yajna
text: Purify the atmosphere and mind through sacred Vedic fire offerings and collective mantra chanting.
expect: What to expect: 45–60 min ceremony with samagri, ghee offerings, Gayatri & Shanti Path.
alt: Devotees in traditional attire gathered around a sacred Havan kund

title: Shodasha Vedic Sanskars
text: Celebrate life’s sacred milestones—from Namkaran and Annaprashan to Yagyopaveet and Griha Pravesh.
expect: What to expect: Performed per Maharshi Dayananda’s Sanskar Vidhi with clear meaning.
alt: Elder guiding a young man during a traditional Yagyopaveet sanskar ceremony

title: Vedic Vivah (Marriage)
text: Begin married life with solemn Vedic vows, Saptapadi around the sacred Agni, and simplicity.
expect: What to expect: Dignified ceremony with translated Sanskrit vows and zero ostentation.
alt: Vedic Saptapadi marriage ceremony beside the sacred Agni Yajna fire

title: Swadhyaya & Gurukul Vidya
text: Study the four Vedas, Upanishads, Sanskrit grammar, and Satyarth Prakash with Acharya guidance.
expect: What to expect: Open study circles, Sandhya training, and youth character-building classes.
alt: Ancient Rigveda manuscript written in Devanagari script

title: Ravivar Satsang & Pravachan
text: Gather every Sunday morning for soulful Vedic bhajans, Yajna, and ethical discourse.
expect: What to expect: Open congregation for all families followed by community prasad.
alt: Community members gathered together for an evening satsang
